description:
Idle Loops is an incremental game with light optimisation elements.
You're stuck in a time loop and explore the world around you,
getting a little bit stronger and doing a little more each loop.

0.4.1.description:
# Idle Loops AP 0.4.1

## APWorld
* Fixed generation issues
* Added "Progressive Lootable" filler item (with option to disable) to smooth out unlucky starts/seeds
* Added 2 Rep + 10 Short Quests to Z1 logic
    * _I first added Progressive Lootables, then still had an abysmally unlucky test seed where I had basically nothing after doing all low-mana checks, so both these lines are attempts to solve the same issue. I'm not happy though, forcing 10 Short Quests feels a bit heavy handed._
* Removed "Hard Logic" option for now, turns out the one use case I had for it was patched on the new fork, oops.

## Client
* Supports above changes
* Fixed a few places where internal action names are displayed instead of the more readable ones
    * _i.e. "SQuests" > "Short Quest" and such_

## Idle Loops AP 0.4.1.1
_(The only download below, I removed the 0.4.1 one)_

## APWorld
* Fixed Buy Mana not being in Sphere 0 for Z1 goal
* Removed Meet People/Investigate from Sphere 0 for Z2+ goal, the 10 Short Quests in Z1 logic should cover the hole I wanted with that

## Client
* Stopped scouting Progress bars/Lootable actions from sending a hint
* Fixed the predictor not taking Starting Gold/Mana filler items into account until the first action in the list is changed after connecting

0.4.2.description:
## Idle Loops AP 0.4.2 ##
#### "I have no control over the versioning scheme i chose this is a major release despite being versioned as a patch" ####

### APWorld: ###
- Rewrote everything for options, and as such:
- Options!
	- Toggles for location types
	- Set max level per location type
	- Goal based defaults (That are reasonable and playtested this time!)
		- (Probably should have been presets)
	- You can assume the new features below also have options to enable/disable them.
- Added "Mana Logic" for Z1, i.e. AP knows exactly (well, underestimates) how much mana/gold you can get and what locations are possible
	- This let me turn off the heavy handed previous logic and now playthroughs of Z1 actually feel different!
- Added a "Shop" to Z1/3 to buy checks for ramping gold costs
- Respect Vanilla skill requirements for actions (i.e. Heal The Sick's "Unlocked at 12 Magic")
	- Unsupported additional option to also respect progress bar requirements, it's all implemented and working i just don't want complaints about Fill Errors or how close to vanilla it feels
- Make Mana Reduction actions a requirement for what they reduce
- Logically guarantee 10k mana from Z1 into Z2
- Require Glasses to be in Z1
- Add a second Glasses to the pool (you start the loop with Glasses if you have both)
- Batch Wild Mana and Herbs 10x
- Added a "Nothing" filler item
- Added Gamespeed, Stat Exp and Skill Exp mults, both global and as items.
	(No skill exp item it would feel bad to spend time leveling something then get an item that would have sped it up by 10%)
- Generally improved logic all around

### Client: ###
- Also rewrote everything but for no reason
	- That's a lie things are properly laid out now i have a build process and everything
- Colourful message log
	- Corrected colours on Lloyd's fork's dark mode so these colours align with other AP clients and Strength is Red again.
- Redid scouting properly (compared to the very minimal original), largely a code difference but they're colourful now (and are placed in every relevant tooltip)
- This feels like retreading the above but did your eyes gloss over 'Added a "Shop"'? That needed me to figure out how to inject actions into the game!
	- Another thing that would have been way easier if i forked the game rather than a client mod.
- Added a tooltip to the "AP log" title displaying received non-action items
- Fixed starting items not having an effect the first loop after connecting

And a whole lot of internal changes, optimizations and improvements (as implied by rewriting everything) that aren't really user facing so i didn't want to turn them into a patch note.

0.4.5.description:
## IdleLoopsAP 0.4.5 ##
### Skill Stuff ###

* Skill level gaps between locations now grows over time, repeating each x10
* Added logic for
  * Only 10 Magic/Combat levels are in logic until you can do at least 5 training actions in a loop
  * First couple of levels of Combat via Small Dungeon, Large Dungeon, and Pyromancy with Fight Monsters
  * All Combat via Pyromancy with Hunt Trolls
  * First couple of level of Magic via Small Dungeon, Large Dungeon
  * 30 Magic via Learn Alchemy/Brew Potions
  * 50 Herbs needed for Alchemy
  * 25 Alchemy via Brew Potions
    * With a few playtests NONE of these were actually used but, ya know, they're in there now.
* Some "Glitched" logic for UT
* Improvements for Mana Logic
  * Correctly handles Starting Gold
  * Correctly handles Heal The Sick... That was an embarrassing one to not be working
  * Option to put Pots > 2 Locks > Buy Mana into logic (very inefficient)
  * An /explain that tells you how much mana it thinks you can get to.

0.4.6.description:
## IdleLoopsAP 0.4.6 ##

### Minor update ###

* Deathlink support
  * Receiving a Deathlink ends the current loop
  * For sending them, "Death" isn't a concept in this game, there's nothing that really fit so I made it local-only trap items.
* Split Chrono/Pyromancy off from normal difficulty skills.
  * i.e. Default max 200 > 50
* Added Imbue Body (... I skipped it before because I thought it was imbue Soul)
  * (...also, added a source of Soulstones as a logical requirement for Imbue Mind/Body and upped its Default max to 10)
* Remove "Fight Segments" option, thinking about it again there's kinda no reason for it.
  * (It's always 5 now)
* Added an option to have Throw Party logically required for 51%+ Meet People/Short Quest, defaults to off
* Removed an accidental "Z1 - Shop (Expensive)" item that shouldn't have existed
